spellbook.finance/limitations: This reads only the customer represented by the MCP login. It accepts no email, user id, workspace, URL, credential, or token argument.
A successful status read does not create or change a connection. The seller is the only person who can approve the eBay consent page returned by spellbook_ebay_connect_link.
Treat data.missingFields and data.limitations as unknowns. An active connection does not prove seller bootstrap is complete or that any listing is live.

description: Check whether this signed-in customer's eBay seller account is connected to SpellBook Finance. Call this before requesting a connect link and call it again after the seller approves eBay consent. It returns the stored account identity and token state plus current eBay seller-registration and selling-limit facts. If connected is false and account is null, call spellbook_ebay_connect_link. If status is revoked, fetch a fresh connect link.
name: spellbook_ebay_connection_status
